title: Allow Condition.notify() when underlying lock is held directly

+    async def test_notify_with_shared_lock(self) -> None:
+        lock = Lock()
+        condition = Condition(lock)
+        async with lock:
+            condition.notify()
+            condition.notify_all()
+
+    async def test_notify_no_lock(self) -> None:
+        condition = Condition()
+        with pytest.raises(
+            RuntimeError, match="The current task is not holding the underlying lock"
+        ):
+            condition.notify()
+
+        with pytest.raises(
+            RuntimeError, match="The current task is not holding the underlying lock"
+        ):
+            condition.notify_all()
+
+    async def test_notify_after_release(self) -> None:
+        condition = Condition()
+        await condition.acquire()
+        condition.release()
+        with pytest.raises(
+            RuntimeError, match="The current task is not holding the underlying lock"
+        ):
+            condition.notify()
+
